limitations: CAL is reused for checkpoint selection; it is not an independent test.
All views of a native region are correlated. Historical initialization exposure is retained in the original source audit.
The joint development holdout was already evaluated historically and cannot become a new blind test.
No source-backed exact font labels exist for the user screenshots; they are not training targets or accuracy benchmarks.
Passing all retention constraints does not imply passing the original stable accuracy requirements.
The permitted one-percentage-point Android and three-percentage-point family coverage losses were declared before training.

interpretation: Current additive losses use independent samples; forcing same-batch placement alone does not introduce a paired loss in the GroupNorm model.
For unknown BCE target .5, log-odds derivative is p_unknown-.5. Old unknown examples above .5 are pushed downward while all unknown examples are excluded from the current KL mask.
This is direct loss-direction evidence, not proof of single-cause CAL regression. The next teacher and mask change is a joint preservation strategy, not a coefficient sweep.
paired_known_training_diagnosis.limitation: The counted probabilities belong to cached historical core teacher outputs, not stepwise student outputs or measured student gradients. Teacher identity and KL mask change together in the planned trial.

teacher_preserve_train_cache.statistics_scope: All three prepared TRAIN caches in tile_start order; statistics count tiles, not sampled batches, unique native regions, named predictions, or student gradients.
teacher_preserve_train_cache.probability_definition: Full 25-class softmax at T=1, accumulated in float64; strict >0.5 and >0.7.
